record.body:
## Problem

The task table shows status, title, wave, phase, and assignee. Phase size lives only as a `Size:` line in the phase body (`one sitting` or `more than one`). Each task's executor lives only as `payload.executor` (`inline` or `subagent`). Neither appears on the table or on the task detail chips, so a scan of the dashboard does not show how large a phase was estimated to be or how each task will run.

## Approach

Decision: glance-run-facts.

Read the facts already recorded. Do not add a size field to the phase payload, and do not add a table column.

The snapshot lists each phase with its body. A `Size:` line becomes `one sitting` or `more than one` (`more than one sitting` counts as `more than one`). The phase header appends ` · <size>` after the done/total count when a size is present. The header does not show an executor, because waves in one phase can differ.

Each task row carries `executor` from the work-item payload. A missing or empty value is `subagent`. The task title appends a dim ` · inline` or ` · subagent`. Clipping shortens the title and keeps that suffix. Task detail adds an `executor inline` or `executor subagent` chip beside the assignee chip.

This phase edits `dashboard/model.py`, `dashboard/tasks.py`, and `dashboard/task_detail.py`. evidence-view is in progress on those files, so this phase starts after that branch is on main.

## Exit criteria

A seeded phase body `Size: one sitting` and `Size: more than one sitting` show `one sitting` and `more than one` on the phase header, and a body with no Size line shows none. Verified by `tests/test_dashboard_model.py` and `tests/test_dashboard_app.py` at 60 columns.

A work-item with `executor` `inline`, `executor` `subagent`, and no executor shows `inline`, `subagent`, and `subagent` on the task title and as an `executor` chip on task detail. Same tests, at 60 columns, with the suffix surviving title clipping.

The phase header does not gain `inline` or `subagent` from the tasks' executors. App test at 60 columns.

payload.title: Show phase size and task executor on the task table
